purpose: Non-admission discovery of source-original physical climate risk hazard indicators, a multi-peril impact-function discovery portal and a licensed historical US disaster-loss database. These are distinct capabilities, not independently verified CAT loss inputs.

entries.name: OS-Climate Physrisk public hazard-indicator collection
entries.provider: OS-Climate / Open Source Climate / AWS Open Data
entries.spatial_scope: Multi-region/global depending on each individual hazard array, scenario and original data source
entries.temporal_scope: Historical baselines and climate projection periods vary by individual indicator; collection is updated and not a single fixed release
entries.resolution_or_granularity: 3-dimensional hazard indicator arrays indexed by hazard-specific return period or threshold and spatial grid, with inventory paths, CRS, units and scenario metadata; public S3 bucket without AWS credentials
entries.note: AWS registry identifies s3://os-climate-physical-risk (us-east-1), accessible with aws s3 ls --no-sign-request. Canonical inventory at https://github.com/os-climate/hazard/blob/main/src/inventories/hazard/inventory.json maps individual hazard resources to model/provider lineages and index semantics. https://github.com/os-climate/physrisk is the separate Apache-2.0 computational engine, NOT a new independent hazard observation. The inventory includes WRI Aqueduct Floods products already represented in OpenCatastrophe; preserve upstream identity and avoid counting transformed indicators as independent validation. A listing or unrestricted AWS notice is not an exact-asset SHA, original-vintage proof, automatic commercial sublicense of upstream assets, or scientific/model admission.

entries.name: OpenVulnerability multi-hazard physical impact model discovery library
entries.provider: Roberto Gentile / University College London and collaborators
entries.spatial_scope: Model-specific local, regional and international applicability; no one global loss calibration
entries.temporal_scope: Continuously updated model library, reported approximately six-month refresh cadence; catalogue observation 2026-11-04
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Model-level hazard, GED4ALL asset taxonomy, intensity variable, fragility/vulnerability/consequence category, source provenance and downloadable individual Excel model files
entries.note: Official FAQ distinguishes fragility state probabilities, vulnerability expected loss ratios and consequence repair-cost/downtime outputs; they are not interchangeable. Includes source collections already registered separately in OpenCatastrophe (e.g. ESRM20, GEM, JRC and HAZUS): these must be cross-linked, not recounted as independent originals. Browse and single-model downloads are free according to provider FAQ; organisational bulk/API access needs partnership. The portal is a discovery/harmonisation layer, not a blanket licence for each underlying model; verify exact model source, units, damage metric, site/structure fit and original rights before any conversion, redistribution or CAT engine use. Provider site terms: https://openvulnerability.robertogentile.org/terms.

entries.name: SHELDUS spatial hazard events and losses database for the United States
entries.provider: Center for Emergency Management and Homeland Security / Arizona State University
entries.spatial_scope: United States by state and county, with source-dependent hazard/event coverage
entries.temporal_scope: Historical event records and aggregated series; version and extraction period to be pinned at authorised retrieval
entries.resolution_or_granularity: CSV historical hazard losses by county/date/hazard and named event; source provides separately priced raw records and spatial/temporal/hazard aggregate downloads
entries.note: Publisher requires registered account and query/purchase, with commercial raw-record pricing and subscriptions for aggregated downloads; exact end-user licence governs use. South Carolina data have a stated free-access exception, which does NOT imply all-state redistribution. Potential overlap/derivation from NOAA Storm Events means this is not automatically an independent holdout. Raw event losses and aggregate economic damage do not imply insured losses or company-level TIV; review definitions, inflation, hazard labels, joins, source vintage and allowed derivative scope. Do not automate acquisition or ingest into public or private production stores without explicit rights and original-byte provenance.
